skill.name: safe-debug
skill.description: Conservative debugging workflow for deep learning research failures. It diagnoses tracebacks, CUDA OOM errors, checkpoint mismatches, shape issues, and NaN loss symptoms before any patching.
skill.summary: Diagnose deep learning research failures before making code changes.

content.value_statement: Deep learning failures can lead to risky trial-and-error patches. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through conservative diagnosis, clear evidence, and approval before edits.
actual_capabilities: Classifies common machine learning failures from supplied error text.
Handles CUDA OOM, checkpoint mismatch, distributed, device, shape, NaN, and missing-file symptoms.
Produces diagnosis, patch-plan, and status outputs when the helper script is used.
Separates debugging fixes from research-impact changes.
Requires explicit patch approval before repository edits.
Recommends savepoints before medium-risk or high-risk fixes.
limitations: It does not automatically inspect an entire repository.
It does not run experiments or verify training outcomes.
Incomplete tracebacks can reduce diagnosis quality.
The helper script writes local output files unless JSON mode is used.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Training Failures
use_cases.description: Analyze a traceback or symptom and identify the likely failure category before changing code.

use_cases.title: Review Research Fix Scope
use_cases.description: Separate a necessary debug fix from a change that may alter experiment meaning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Safe Patch Plans
use_cases.description: Create a minimal patch plan with approval and savepoint guidance before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Traceback
prompt_templates.prompt: Use safe-debug on this traceback. Classify the failure, explain the likely cause, and suggest the smallest safe next step.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze CUDA OOM
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CUDA out-of-memory error. Identify likely configuration causes before suggesting any model code changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Minimal Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a conservative patch plan for this failure. Include required evidence, approval needs, and savepoint guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Research Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether this proposed debug fix changes experiment meaning, comparability, or reported results. Recommend a safe decision path.

output_examples.input: A training run fails with CUDA out of memory during the first batch.
output_examples.output: The skill classifies the issue as CUDA OOM and recommends checking batch size, input resolution, and mixed precision first.

output_examples.input: A checkpoint load reports missing keys and unexpected keys.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies a checkpoint mismatch and asks the user to verify model variant and load strictness before compatibility code.

output_examples.input: A loss becomes NaN after a few iterations.
output_examples.output: The skill flags a NaN loss symptom and suggests checking data ranges, loss inputs, precision, and learning rate.

best_practices: Provide the full traceback, command, and recent change context.
Ask for diagnosis before requesting any code edits.
Create a savepoint before applying a medium-risk or high-risk fix.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for broad refactors without a concrete failure.
Do not treat a debug fix as a research contribution by default.
Do not patch model logic before checking configuration and data assumptions.

faq.question: Does this skill edit code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It requires explicit approval before patching repository code.

faq.question: What errors does it handle best?
faq.answer: It works best with tracebacks, CUDA OOM errors, checkpoint mismatches, shape issues, NaN loss, and missing files.

faq.question: Can it run training jobs?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on conservative diagnosis and patch planning from supplied evidence.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: What files can the helper script create?
faq.answer: It can create diagnosis, patch plan, and status outputs in the selected output directory.

faq.question: When should I avoid this skill?
faq.answer: Avoid it for broad repository familiarization, speculative adaptation, and large readability rewrites.
